quarterly_data.signal: Company 2H'26 business plan (IR deck dated 08-05-2026, consolidated): 2H'26 revenue approx. KRW 1,071.9bn (YoY +40%, HoH +14%) and operating profit approx. KRW 163.1bn (YoY +620%, HoH +113%) - 'High OPM on an improved AI high value-added mix', with margin gains expected to continue on higher utilization and AI sales. By segment: MSAP approx. KRW 668.1bn (YoY +37%, HoH +18%; 3Q product-mix improvement accelerating around System IC and AI products, 4Q growth as value-added share rises); HDI approx. KRW 320.5bn (YoY +93%, HoH +42%; AI SOCAMM module sales expansion accelerating and a wider response to next-gen LPCAMM and CXL module demand); Tenting approx. KRW 83.3bn (YoY -25%, HoH -42%; strategically maintaining global top-level market share). The deck notes these are forward-looking company estimates.

quarterly_data.signal: Q2'26 revenue by product group (IR deck, preliminary, consolidated): MSAP (high value-added SiP module, FC-CSP, MCP and GDDR substrates) approx. KRW 307.2bn (YoY +56%, QoQ +18%) - FC-CSP growth led by System IC and Automotive applications, SiP module entering a full-scale growth phase, MCP QoQ growth accelerating led by M-DRAM products, GDDR stable growth; HDI (module PCBs for PC, server, SSD and AI SOCAMM) approx. KRW 127.8bn (YoY +39%, QoQ +31%) with solid growth across server, SSD and PC module PCBs; Tenting (BOC and other non-core products) approx. KRW 79.6bn (YoY +52%, QoQ +24%). SYSTEM IC products: Q2'26 approx. KRW 76.4bn (QoQ +24%) - FC-CSP approx. KRW 57.6bn (QoQ +27%, growth centred on Server and Automotive) and SiP module approx. KRW 18.8bn (QoQ +14%); company forecasts 3Q'26 approx. KRW 89.1bn (QoQ +17%, mix improving on high-ASP products) and 4Q'26 approx. KRW 96.6bn (QoQ +8%), with System IC rising to ~18% of company revenue; 2H'26 System IC revenue approx. KRW 185.7bn (HoH +34%) and FY'26 approx. KRW 323.8bn (YoY +61%); strategy: diversifying customers and applications (Automotive, RF-SiP) on MSAP technology.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2'26: MSAP KRW 307.2bn (+56% YoY), HDI KRW 127.8bn (+39%), Tenting KRW 79.6bn (+52%); System IC Q2 KRW 76.4bn, FY'26 forecast KRW 323.8bn (+61%), ~18% of revenue by 4Q'26

quarterly_data.signal: SOCAMM (AI memory module) ramp, per the IR deck: SOCAMM module described as a new growth driver beginning full ramp-up in Q2'26. SOCAMM-related revenue Q2'26 approx. KRW 39.3bn (QoQ +109%) - SOCAMM module approx. KRW 25.0bn (QoQ +117%) and MCP substrate for SOCAMM approx. KRW 14.3bn (QoQ +96%). Company forecasts: 3Q'26 approx. KRW 72.3bn (QoQ +84%, 'entering the expansion phase for AI SOCAMM module sales') and 4Q'26 approx. KRW 98.9bn (QoQ +37%, 5.3x vs 1Q); 2H'26 KRW 171.2bn (HoH +195%) and FY'26 KRW 229.3bn, of which SOCAMM module approx. KRW 157.5bn and MCP for SOCAMM approx. KRW 71.8bn. Simmtech offers a one-stop solution supplying both SOCAMM modules and their substrates, and is expanding into next-gen LPCAMM and CXL modules/substrates. 3Q-4Q'26 figures are company estimates.
quarterly_data.figure: SOCAMM revenue Q2'26 KRW 39.3bn (+109% QoQ); forecast 3Q KRW 72.3bn, 4Q KRW 98.9bn; FY'26 KRW 229.3bn (module KRW 157.5bn + MCP KRW 71.8bn)

quarterly_data.signal: End-market outlook in Simmtech's IR deck (company figures citing Gartner / Omdia): GDDR7 transition in earnest in '25 with adoption still rising in '26 and the GDDR market expected to grow at an 18% CAGR over '26-'30; NAND/M-DRAM shipments '26-'30 CAGR 10% as LPDDR5 adoption rises; SSD shipments '26-'30 CAGR +6% and memory-module PCB end-market demand '26-'30 CAGR +5%; wearable device market '26-'30 CAGR 3%.
